page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. It features 48 physical cores and 48 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz with a single thread per core. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The underlying virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks indicate solid capabilities across compute and memory subsystems. The instance achieves a PassMark CPU score of 41011.18 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 13191.0, both placing in the average tier. Notably, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression performance is strong, reaching 206.4 GB/sec, which falls within the top 25% of tested systems. Memory performance is also a highlight, with a PassMark memory score of 2786.2, indicating efficient data transfer rates. Read-only memory bandwidth for small cached blocks reaches 2791.31 GB/sec, while large uncached blocks sustain 127.79 GB/sec.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.hfg7.12xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency by providing dedicated physical cores without hyperthreading overhead, ensuring predictable compute performance. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs makes it a cost-effective choice for workloads that do not require hardware acceleration or high-speed local NVMe drives. This server is well-suited for multi-threaded data processing, database operations, static web serving, and general-purpose enterprise applications that benefit from high clock speeds and dedicated CPU allocation.
